reasoning: The LLM fidelity evaluation flagged the document for review with a composite score of 0.7926. There are several major structural issues that block auto-approval, including broken heading hierarchy (H1s assigned incorrectly), 125 retained header/footer elements, 11 displaced hyperlinks, and list numbering restarts. concerns.analysis: The heading hierarchy is broken. The document title is correctly assigned H1 on page 1. Section 2 is assigned H2. This breaks the hierarchy structure for screen reader users.
